item.title: NNPD: Man dead after being shot on J. Clyde Morris Blvd., 1 detained
item.description: A man is dead after being shot on J. Clyde Morris Boulevard in Newport News, while a person of interest has been detained, police said.

item.title: FBI: DNA recovered from glove found near Guthrie home that appears to match glove worn by suspect
item.description: A glove containing DNA found about two miles from the house of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie’s mother appears to match those worn by a masked person outside her front door in Tucson the night she vanished, the FBI said Sunday. The glove, discovered in a field beside a road, was sent for DNA testing. [...]

item.title: Chesapeake Fire Department contains Cedar Road blaze
item.description: The Chesapeake Fire Department responded to a structure fire in the 1700 block of Cedar Road, which was declared under control in 18 minutes with no injuries reported and the primary residence unaffected.

item.title: Battle of Pretty Lake: Norfolk man buys property, claims he is not allowed to use it
item.description: What happens when you buy land, and then you can’t use it? One Norfolk man said it is happening to him, and he has been stuck in a legal battle with the city for the past four years.

item.title: CPD: Investigate vehicle shooting of woman in yellow Jeep
item.description: CHESAPEAKE, Va. (WAVY) -- Chesapeake police are investigating a shooting that left an adult woman injured Saturday afternoon., according to police. item.title: Chesapeake firefighters battle two-alarm blaze at A1 Auto
item.description: Units from the Chesapeake Fire Department are currently on scene battling a two-alarm commercial structure fire in the South Norfolk neighborhood Sunday afternoon, according to officials.

item.title: Former FBI profiler and Virginia forensics professor analyzes Nancy Guthrie kidnapping suspect
item.description: WAVY interviewed Retired FBI profiler Mary Ellen O'Toole Friday to get her analysis of what we know so far about the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, mother of Today Show host Savannah Guthrie.

item.title: Investigation underway after fuel spill in James River
item.description: A fuel spill was identified during a JP5 fuel load transfer from a Navy barge to the John F. Kennedy (CVN 79) in the James River on Friday, and cleanup and remediation efforts were initiated immediately to contain the fuel and protect the surrounding environment.

item.title: SWAT trucks and multiple police cars at Virginia Beach scene
item.description: 10 On Your Side was on scene of an active police situation at Baccalaureate Drive and Hallowed Hall Road in Virginia Beach Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Perdue driver dead after tractor-trailer crash at the Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel
item.description: A driver for Perdue Farms is dead after a tractor-trailer crash at the Chesapeake Bay Bridge-Tunnel (CBBT) Sunday morning, according to Perdue Farms in a statement.
